title: The Two-Person Saw of Cardboard
youtube_title: The Two-Person Saw of Cardboard | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a cardboard saw, pretend, but the counting still had to match will go wrong if one person rushes. Farah and Yuri split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
